Timing & reading

Changes note spacing, not the song or judgment windows.

Positive values compensate for consistently late taps. Bluetooth or different devices may need different settings.

Device & performance

Audio pathNot initialized
RenderingAuto · waiting for test
Ready to test

After changing phones, computers, speakers or Bluetooth headphones, rerun timing calibration.

Controls

Select a lane, then press its replacement. Space and Escape are reserved for pause. Every lane must use a different key.

Touch players can use the four full-width lane pads. Keyboard and touch can be mixed during the same session.

Comfort & accessibility

Lane identityEach lane has a permanent shape and number in addition to its color.
JudgmentsPerfect, Great, Good and Miss are always written as text; color is supplemental.
MenusNative buttons, dialogs, visible focus rings and a skip-to-content link support keyboard navigation.
AudioMusic, tap feedback and master volume are independently adjustable.

Your progress

Local to this browser. No account, cloud, or tracking. Arcade earns cosmetic XP and mastery; Practice and demos never change progression. All songs stay unlocked.

Getting started

Replay the first-run guide at any time, or jump directly into the no-fail lesson. Nothing here affects your records.

Core music release QA

Phase 11 corrected the strongest repetition and fatigue risks automatically. Final approval still requires listening: hook, section contrast, mix clarity, fatigue, distinctness and replay value.

Core chart playtest QA

Phase 12 calibrates lane flow, holds, jumps and difficulty spacing automatically. Final chart approval still requires a real 1.0× playtest of all 54 Core charts.

How scoring works

Perfect: ±45 ms (100%). Great: ±90 ms (80%). Good: ±145 ms (50%). Tap and hold-tail judgments count equally. Hold to the end, with 90 ms release grace. One million is a perfect score on every chart. Stray taps break combo and reduce score.

Stars: 65% / 85% / 95% accuracy on a completed run. S: 97%. S+: every judgment Perfect, with no stray taps. Full Combo means no misses and no stray taps. All tracks are always available.

Settings save automatically.

THREE MOVES. A WHOLE LOT OF MUSIC.

Find the line.

DFJK
01

Tap at the white line. Match the center of the falling note to its receptor. Press its key or touch anywhere in that lane.

02

Two notes? Both hands. Chords arrive together. Press both lanes at the same time.

03

A long tail? Keep holding. Release when the tail reaches the line. A hold has a head and a tail to score.

Start with Chill or try Practice at 75% speed. Space or Escape pauses safely; switching tabs pauses automatically.

No failure in the lesson.

Meet your controls.

02 · READ THE NOTES
Tap

Press once when the note center reaches the white line.

Chord

Two notes arrive together. Press both lanes at the same time.

Hold

Keep the key down through the tail, then release near its end.
